classified.title: Nitheesh Abraham vs Liberty Videocon General Insurance ... on 30 July, 2026
classified.reason: Individual motor accident compensation appeal; fact-specific enhancement of consortium amount with no systemic direction or new precedent.

classified.title: National Insurance Company Limited vs Smt. Thungala Dhana Laxmi on 4 August, 2026
classified.reason: Though originating as an insurance appeal, the Court issued sweeping nationwide systemic directions on uninsured vehicles, enforcement, uniform policy structure, IRDA/MoRTH pilot projects and MACT case expedition, with continued compliance monitoring.

classified.title: Rama vs Kedar on 4 August, 2026
classified.reason: Individual motor accident compensation appeal confined to notional income of the deceased; applies existing Pranay Sethi principles without systemic road-safety relief.

gists.gist: The Court directed renewal of a fixed deposit maturing on 11.08.2026 for a further three months.
gists.latest_development: On 4 August 2026, the Court ordered renewal of the fixed deposit maturing on 11.08.2026 for three months and listed the matters for 12.08.2026.
